chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub al-Kulayni, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan and 'Ali ibn Muhammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Mahbub, from Ibn Ri'ab, from Bukayr ibn A'yan, who said:

Abu Ja'far عليه السلام used to say: Indeed, Allah took the covenant of our Shi'ah concerning the wilayah while they were particles, on the day when He took the covenant from the particles, and the acknowledgment for Him of Lordship, and for Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله of prophethood.

key_terms.الرُّبُوبِيَّةِ: Lordship, Allah’s exclusive divine sovereignty and sustenance
key_terms.بِالنُّبُوَّةِ: with prophethood; affirmation of the prophetic mission of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.بِالْوَلَايَةِ: with the wilayah, meaning divinely ordained authority and allegiance
key_terms.ذَرٌّ: minute particles; referring to the primordial state of creation
key_terms.شِيعَتِنَا: the followers and adherents of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.مِيثَاقَ: a solemn covenant or binding pledge taken by Allah

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about the primordial covenant of the Shi'ah and wilayah?
ai.summary: This hadith states that Allah took a primordial covenant from the Shi'ah regarding wilayah at the time of the covenant of the ذرّ. It joins together acknowledgment of Allah’s rububiyyah, the nubuwwah of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله, and allegiance to the divinely appointed authority.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yaqoub Al Kulayni, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan, and Ali Bin Muhammad, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Qaib, from Bukeyr Bin Ayn who said,

‘Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Took the Covenant of our<sup>asws</sup> Shias with the Wilayah, and they were particles on the Day the Covenant was Taken upon the particles, and the acknowledgment to Him<sup>azwj</sup> of the Lordship, and to Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> with the Prophet-hood’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn ya‘qub al-Kulayni has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Hassan and Ali ibn Muhammad from Sahl ibn Ziyad from ibn Mahbub from ibn Al-Ri’ab from Bukayr ibn ‘A‘yan who has said the following.

“Abu Ja‘far (a.s.) used to say, “Allah made our Shi‘a (followers) to acknowledge our Wilaya Leadership with Divine Authority) when they were only in the realm of small particles. It was the day when Allah made the small particles to acknowledge Him as the Lord and Muhammad (s.a) as His prophet.”
